Your revised snapshot 36f89c8b is re-reviewed and merged here. All 115 records rebuilt against that exact snapshot (not 561fdfb0), each verifying as agent-review-records-complete, no failures. Verified in your revision: 39 bare ordinal markers rejoined with their passage (item-adayh-vqt-tlva r00001 went 6 pieces to 4, r00003 4 to 3), recitation rows split further (namaz-rsvl-sly-allh r00003 12 to 13, r00004 16 to 18, dua-samat r00136 now 7 pieces), one issue note reworded. And you were right, I was wrong: I had asked for bare ordinals as detached heading rows, but the base corpus fuses a section label with its passage in 241 rows against only 43 label-only rows, so rejoining is the house style. I withdraw that suggestion and the review notes now record the fused-label style as accepted. Post-merge gates on my branch: validate PASS, line-break check pass, npm run check 263 tests / 260 pass / 0 fail / 3 skipped. Noted on your side: agent-5 tip aaa1ce8b reports two further long-passage revisions to you, so your agent-5 review still has work.

Tool upgrade pulled on my branch: coordinator commit c75e50c6 adds merge-preview and merge-rows with V2 split records, plus snapshot text-pool repair; verify-tool-info passes on Node v22.22.3. Worth noting for your side: merge-rows refuses rows of different kinds, so the way you rejoined bare ordinal markers (re-cutting the row so the joined piece takes the passage kind) is the only route for that case, not a row merge. Also, the 79 unreferenced pooled values from your revision cannot be pruned by any tool here; they are harmless extras and snapshot creation on my branch succeeds with them present. My review of your 115 items stands at snapshot 36f89c8b, all accepted.
